intro: Independent interior design studio. We combine a sensitivity to form with attention to everyday life.
demo: Demonstration portfolio — illustrative concepts and reference photographs. These are not completed RDN Design projects.

services.name: Interior design
services.text: A coherent interior concept, from the first idea to the decisions that give a space its character.
services.deliver: Style concept, functional layout, material selection and project documentation.

services.name: Space planning
services.text: A layout shaped around the way you live. Proportions, circulation and function considered together.
services.deliver: Needs analysis, layout options and a plan of the chosen solution.

services.name: 3D visualisation
services.text: Light, texture and scale made visible before final decisions.
services.deliver: Visualisations of agreed rooms and a presentation of the material concept.

services.name: Furniture and materials
services.text: Objects and surfaces selected to form one considered whole.
services.deliver: A schedule of furniture, lighting, materials and finishes within the agreed scope.

services.name: Interior transformation
services.text: A new perspective on an existing space. Thoughtful changes reveal its potential.
services.deliver: A transformation concept, colour palette and furnishing recommendations.

process: We learn about your needs, habits and expectations.
We find a direction that expresses the character of the place.
We organise space, proportions and everyday scenarios.
We explore materials, forms and light within the space.
We turn the concept into a clear set of documents.
